This notebook performs OLGA and SoNNia analyses to quantify the probability of CDR3β generation and produce $P_{gen}$ and $P_{post}$ statistics for each receptor. Then we perform distribution testing across samples as a pairwise distance metric.

## Analysis Setup

Environment setup

```{r setup, include=FALSE}

#| message: false

library(janitor)

```

## Visualizing & analyzing SoNNia results

```{r}
sonnia_case_df <- read_csv(
    glue("{sonnia_output_dir}/tcrb_case_results_2025-07-09/tcrb_case_results.csv")) %>%
    mutate(case_control_other_latest = "Case") %>% 
    glimpse()

sonnia_ctrl_df <- read_csv(
    glue("{sonnia_output_dir}/tcrb_ctrl_results_2025-07-09/tcrb_ctrl_results.csv")) %>%
    mutate(case_control_other_latest = "Control") %>% 
    glimpse()

sonnia_df <- bind_rows(sonnia_case_df, sonnia_ctrl_df) %>% glimpse()

# Visualizing SoNNia results
sonnia_df %>% glimpse()
trust4_reports_tcrb %>% glimpse()

tcrb_df <- trust4_reports_tcrb %>% 
    left_join(sonnia_df, 
        by = c("CDR3aa" = "amino_acid", "v_gene", "j_gene", "case_control_other_latest")
    ) %>% 
    filter(!is.na(Q_data)) %>% 
    glimpse()

write_csv(tcrb_df, glue("{wkdir}/data/interim/airr/tcrb_soNNia_{Sys.Date()}.csv"))

```


```{r}
tcrb_df <- fread(
    glue("{wkdir}/data/interim/airr/tcrb_soNNia_2025-08-20.csv")) %>%
    glimpse()

tcrb_df %>% glimpse()

# # Visualizing Pgen, Ppost, and Q_data
# tcrb_df %>% 
#     ggplot(aes(x = log10(Q_data), color = DRB1_risk)) +
#     geom_density() +
#     theme_bw() +
#     scale_color_d3() +
#     facet_wrap(~case_control_other_latest) +
#     labs(x = "log10(Pgen)", y = "Density")


sids <- unique(tcrb_df$sample_id)
pairwise_sid_grid <- expand.grid("Sample_1" = sids, "Sample_2" = sids) %>% 
    filter(Sample_1 != Sample_2) %>% 
    glimpse()

# visualizing histrogram binning
sids[1:10]
for (s in sids[1:10]) {
    tcrb_df %>% 
        filter(sample_id == s) %>% 
        pull(Q_data) %>% hist(100)
}



# All are positive distributions (no negative values)
tcrb_df %>% glimpse()
tcrb_df$Q_data %>% summary()
tcrb_df$pgen_data %>% summary()
tcrb_df$ppost_data %>% summary()

q_mat <- tcrb_df %>% 
    # dplyr::filter(sample_id %in% sids[1:50]) %>% 
    dplyr::select(sample_id, Q_data) %>% 
    group_by(sample_id) %>% 
    mutate(row_num = row_number()) %>% 
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = sample_id, values_from = Q_data, 
        values_fill = 0) %>% 
    dplyr::select(-row_num) %>% 
    glimpse()

# rownames(q_mat)

q_mat <- as.matrix(q_mat + 1e-12) %>% t()
# q_mat <- as.matrix(q_mat) %>% t()

jsd_q_prob <- JSD(q_mat, est.prob = "empirical", unit = "log2")
rownames(jsd_q_prob) <- colnames(jsd_q_prob) <- rownames(q_mat)
saveRDS(jsd_q_prob, glue("{sonnia_analysis_dir}/jsd_q_prob_{Sys.Date()}.rds"))

jsd_q_baseline <- JSD(q_mat, unit = "log2")
rownames(jsd_q_baseline) <- colnames(jsd_q_baseline) <- rownames(q_mat)
saveRDS(jsd_q_baseline, glue("{sonnia_analysis_dir}/jsd_q_baseline_{Sys.Date()}.rds"))


# Chopping up values into distributions
tcrb_df$Q_data %>% summary




breaks <- seq(min(tcrb_df$Q_data, na.rm = TRUE),
              max(tcrb_df$Q_data, na.rm = TRUE),
              length.out = 101)          # 200 intervals → 201 breakpoints

tcrb_df <- tcrb_df %>% 
  # assign every Q_data value to one of the 200 bins
  mutate(bin = cut(log10(Q_data),
                   breaks = breaks,
                   include.lowest = TRUE,
                   labels = FALSE)) %>%
  # count how many observations fall into each bin (within each sample)
  group_by(sample_id) %>% 
  add_count(bin, name = "bin_count") %>%
  # convert that count to the probability mass of the bin
  mutate(Q_data_bin = bin_count / n()) %>%     # Σ Q_data_bind == 1
  select(-bin_count, -bin)


# tcrb_df$Q_data_bin %>% table()
# tcrb_df %>% filter(sample_id == "PP-4021-BLM0T1") %>% 
#     pull(Q_data_bin) %>% hist()

tcrb_df$Q_data_bin %>% hist(100)
tcrb_df$Q_data %>% hist(100)

# tcrb_df$Q_data_bin %>% log() %>% hist(200)
# tcrb_df$Q_data %>% log %>% hist(200)

sids[1:10]
for (s in sids[1:10]) {
    vals <- tcrb_df %>% 
        filter(sample_id == s) %>% 
        pull(Q_data_bin) %>% print()
    hist(vals)
}


tibble(sample_id = c("A","A","A","B","B"),
       bin       = c( 1 ,  1 ,  2 , 1 , 2)) %>%
#   group_by(sample_id) %>%
  add_count(bin, name = "bin_count")


tcrb_df %>% 
    select(sample_id, Q_data)
```
